mre-A-baseline.description: Current baseline produced by HwpxCanvasRenderer without modification.

mre-B-wrap-only.description: Conditionally changes lineWrap from BREAK to SQUEEZE for single-line textboxes. Multi-line body paragraph (7:998) remains BREAK.
mre-B-wrap-only.isolatedVariable: lineWrap attribute on hp:subList in Contents/section0.xml

mre-C-lineheight-only.description: Changes fallback lineSpacing from PERCENT 160% to FIXED 1125 HWPUNIT (matching authentic Hancom standard).

mre-D-font-only.description: Changes fontRef mapping for HANGUL from Inter (font id 1) to Malgun Gothic (font id 0), matching DOCX East Asia dual-font model.

mutations.target: hh:fontRef hangul attribute across charPr entries

mre-E-geometry-only.description: Restores center-aligned banner (7:1082) box height from inflated 37.48 pt to authentic text geometry 11.99 pt with top vertical alignment.
mre-E-geometry-only.isolatedVariable: hp:rect dimensions and vertAlign on 7:1082 in Contents/section0.xml

mutations.target: 7:1082 (품질 가공 단계) hp:rect geometry and alignment

mre-F-combined.description: Holistic combination of B (single-line SQUEEZE), C (authentic fixed lineSpacing 1125 HWPU), and D (Hangul font mapping).

mutations.target: hh:fontRef hangul attribute across charPr entries
